name: tux
description: A Linux troubleshooting agent: diagnoses hardware and software problems on your machine, explains what it finds, and applies fixes with your approval.

auto_approve_read_only.title: Auto-approve read-only commands
auto_approve_read_only.description: In tux sessions, run commands that only inspect the system (lspci, journalctl, df, systemctl status, tux-scan…) without asking. Commands that change anything always ask. Off by default.
